description: Diagnose a CRM or operational issue using AI. Provide the CRM name, symptoms, and optionally industry and company context. When an industry is specified, the diagnostic incorporates industry-specific knowledge (common systems, red flags, technology stack). Returns root causes, step-by-step fixes, verification steps, and prevention tips.

client_name.description: Optional: client or company name for audit history tracking

company_context.description: Optional: company size, team structure, or other relevant context

crm_name.description: Name of the CRM system (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Go High Level, Dubsado)

industry.description: Optional: industry vertical for context-aware diagnostics

symptoms.description: Description of the issue or symptoms being experienced

name: run_diagnostic
